# BayCounty.me

> BayCounty.me is a free, independent guide to the public records of Bay County, Florida: its county, cities, school district and special districts. It shows where tax money goes, budgets, contracts and the vendors paid, how officials voted, campaign money, meetings, elections, public notices, schools, restaurant inspections, emergencies and more, each figure linked to its government source.

Maps, money and public records for Bay County, Florida, with a source on every figure.

Run by Flux Labs (https://fluxlabs.net/), a managed IT services company in Panama City. Contact: hello@fluxlabs.net. Free to use; the data is open (see Open data).

## Living here

- [My address](https://baycounty.me/my-address): Your tax bill, trash day, schools, districts and meetings for one address
- [Utilities & trash day](https://baycounty.me/utilities): Who provides what, and your pickup day
- [Public schools](https://baycounty.me/schools): Your zoned schools, calendar, grades and spending
- [Restaurant inspections](https://baycounty.me/restaurants): Every inspection, warning and closure
- [Police, fire & Sheriff](https://baycounty.me/public-safety): Who covers your town, crimes reported, budgets
- [Government jobs](https://baycounty.me/jobs): Open jobs at every local government
- [Beaches](https://baycounty.me/beaches): Today's flag, rip currents, water quality, access
- [Parks](https://baycounty.me/parks): Parks, boat ramps, trails and sign-ups
- [Emergencies & alerts](https://baycounty.me/emergency): Warnings, evacuation zones, shelters, boil-water notices
- [Hurricane prep](https://baycounty.me/hurricane-prep): Sandbags, generators, disaster help
- [Events](https://baycounty.me/events): What's happening around the county
- [New businesses](https://baycounty.me/new-businesses): Companies filed in Bay County, month by month
- [Building & development](https://baycounty.me/development): New homes permitted and projects in review
- [Road projects](https://baycounty.me/roads): State road work, costs and the five-year plan
- [Military and the bases](https://baycounty.me/military): Base news and federal contracts to local firms

## Your money

- [Your tax bill](https://baycounty.me/public-money/tax-dollars): Who gets each dollar of your property tax, for any area
- [Fees & bills](https://baycounty.me/public-money/fees-and-bills): Tax-bill fees, water and garbage
- [Exemptions](https://baycounty.me/public-money/exemptions): Homestead, veterans, seniors and more
- [Tourist tax](https://baycounty.me/public-money/tourist-tax): The 5% bed tax visitors pay
- [Amendment 3](https://baycounty.me/public-money/amendment-3): What the ballot amendment would change
- [Compare governments](https://baycounty.me/compare): Budgets, taxes, debt and audits per resident
- [Budgets by year](https://baycounty.me/public-money/budget-compare): Compare any two years, line by line
- [CRA spending](https://baycounty.me/public-money/cra-spending): What redevelopment agencies paid for
- [CRA tax increment](https://baycounty.me/public-money/cra-tax-increment): Property tax paid to the CRAs, by year
- [Sales tax projects](https://baycounty.me/public-money/sales-tax-projects): Half-cent projects: promised vs built
- [Hurricane Michael](https://baycounty.me/public-money/hurricane-michael): FEMA, HUD and state recovery money
- [Accountability console](https://baycounty.me/public-money/accountability): Big projects from approval to close
- [Contracts](https://baycounty.me/public-money/contracts): Who wins them, and how
- [Vendors](https://baycounty.me/public-money/vendors): Every company paid, with contracts and votes
- [How they voted](https://baycounty.me/public-money/votes): Every recorded vote on money decisions

- [Nonprofits](https://baycounty.me/connections/nonprofits): Public money, and officials on their boards
- [Chambers of commerce](https://baycounty.me/chambers): Boards, events and public money

## Data and API

- [Open data](https://baycounty.me/open-data): 142 datasets as CSV and JSON, refreshed daily
- [Dataset catalog (JSON)](https://baycounty.me/downloads/index.json): every dataset with its columns and download links
- [API and assistant connector](https://baycounty.me/developers): REST API, OpenAPI description and an MCP server for AI assistants
- [OpenAPI description](https://baycounty.me/api/v1/openapi.json): the /api/v1 endpoints
- [MCP server](https://baycounty.me/api/mcp): tools that answer common questions from the same data
- [Data sources](https://baycounty.me/data-sources): every source, link and how often it is read
